item.title: Cook County Circuit Court warns public of scam notice that's been circulating regarding unpaid parking charges
item.description: The office of Cook County Circuit Court Chief Judge Charles Beach issued a fraud alert Sunday warning the public about a scam that's been circulating, which claims to require payment for unpaid parking charges.

item.title: Teravainen scores twice, Soderblom makes 22 saves in Blackhawks' 4-0 win over Mammoth
item.description: SALT LAKE CITY (AP) — Teuvo Teravainen scored twice, Arvid Soderblom made 22 saves for his first NHL shutout and the Chicago Blackhawks beat the Utah Mammoth 4-0 on Sunday to end a three-game losing streak. item.title: State Department urges Americans to 'exercise increased caution' amid Iran military action
item.description: The State Department on Saturday urged Americans to "exercise increased caution” following U.S. military action in Iran and escalating tensions between the two countries.

item.title: 3 people critically injured in 3-vehicle crash after speeding car runs red light on city's North Side, police say
item.description: Six people were involved, three of them critically injured, in a three-vehicle crash early Sunday morning after a speeding car ran a red light on the city's North Side, according to Chicago police.

item.title: Lincolnwood home destroyed after overnight garage fire
item.description: A fire broke out in an attached garage at a home in Lincolnwood early Sunday. The fire spread to the back of the house, causing a total loss.

item.title: Thousands brave icy waters of Lake Michigan for 26th annual Polar Plunge benefiting Special Olympics Illinois
item.description: Chilly temperatures on the first day of March won't stop thousands of people from jumping into Lake Michigan off Chicago's North Avenue Beach on Sunday morning.

item.title: Monday Forecast: Cold start but sunny skies and a warmup are ahead
item.description: We’ll wake up Monday to feels-like temperatures still stuck in the teens, but don’t let that fool you. As the day goes on, highs will climb into the 40s under mostly clear, sunny skies, making for a bright and seasonable afternoon.

item.title: Three US service members killed, five seriously wounded in Iran operation: Military
item.description: They are the first reported American casualties since the U.S. and Israel launched a surprise attack on Iran.

item.title: Protesters in Chicagoland call for peace following U.S. involvement in Iran attack
item.description: Hundreds gathered in the Loop on Saturday to voice their concerns after a major attack on Iran by Israel and the United States.
